findings.evidence: grep -rn "AddSubgroup.closure_induction₂" TauCeti/ → TauCeti/RingTheory/Binomial.lean:148, TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/RingOfDefinition.lean:89, TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/CharacterTable/VirtualCharacter.lean:129. No Mathlib lemma covers it: `Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Subgroup.lean` defines pointwise `AddSubgroup.mul` but has no `mul_le`/`closure_mul_closure`, and `AddSubmonoid.closure_mul_closure` (Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Submonoid/Pointwise.lean:151) is at the submonoid level, so the helper belongs in TauCeti.
findings.fix: Add one shared lemma, e.g. `theorem AddSubgroup.mul_mem_closure {R} [NonUnitalNonAssocRing R] {s : Set R} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, x * y ∈ AddSubgroup.closure s) {x y : R} (hx : x ∈ AddSubgroup.closure s) (hy : y ∈ AddSubgroup.closure s) : x * y ∈ AddSubgroup.closure s`, carrying the six `closure_induction₂` cases once, and reduce all three sites to their `mem` case: here `fun _ ⟨m, rfl⟩ _ ⟨n, rfl⟩ => by rw [choose_mul_choose]; exact sum_mem ...`.
findings.issue: `mul_mem_ringChooseSpan` re-derives, for the third time in TauCeti, the generic step "if `s` is closed under multiplication into `AddSubgroup.closure s`, then `AddSubgroup.closure s` is closed under multiplication". Lines 155-160 are character-for-character identical to `TauCeti/RingTheory/Huber/RingOfDefinition.lean:97-102` (`private mul_mem_addSubgroupClosure_mul_range_pow`), and `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/CharacterTable/VirtualCharacter.lean:126-140` (`mul_mem_virtualCharacters`) is the same proof with `rw` in place of `simpa`. Only the `| mem` case differs at each site.

summary: The product formula and the subring identification are new; Mathlib has no `Ring.choose` product lemma and no span-is-a-subring statement. But `mul_mem_ringChooseSpan`'s closure induction is the third verbatim copy of the same six-case boilerplate in TauCeti and should be factored into one shared lemma.
